title: ProtocolError
description:
The error object of a failed response. `code` is one of the known codes below; clients must treat unknown codes as generic failures (new codes may be added).

- `HANDSHAKE_REQUIRED`: The first request on a connection must be `hello`.
- `BAD_TOKEN`: The `hello` token doesn't match the agent's session token.
- `PROTOCOL_MISMATCH`: The client's protocol version is incompatible with the agent's (different major, or a different minor while the major is 0).
- `INVALID_FRAME`: The frame or its JSON is malformed, or isn't a valid envelope.
- `FRAME_TOO_LARGE`: The frame exceeds the configured maximum size.
- `METHOD_NOT_FOUND`: The agent doesn't implement this method.
- `INVALID_PARAMS`: The params don't match the method's schema or can't be converted.
- `MODE_FORBIDDEN`: The method needs a higher agent mode than the current one (`data.requiredMode`).
- `UNSUPPORTED`: A capability or optional module is unavailable in this game or runtime.
- `INDEX_STALE`: An anchor's module isn't loaded, or its token doesn't resolve in the loaded build.
- `NOT_FOUND`: The object, member, scene, variable or job wasn't found.
- `HANDLE_EXPIRED`: The handle is unknown or released, or its Unity object was destroyed.
- `REF_EXPIRED`: A redaction ref was evicted; use the stub's locator instead.
- `AMBIGUOUS`: Exploratory resolution matched several members (candidates in `data`).
- `GAME_EXCEPTION`: Game code threw during a get, set, invoke or UI action (inner exception in `data`).
- `PATCH_FAILED`: Applying or removing a Harmony patch failed.
- `EXEC_FAILED`: Loading, binding or running a snippet, patch or mod assembly failed (`data.phase`).
- `DUPLICATE_ASSEMBLY`: An assembly with the same name was already loaded by the agent.
- `IO_FAILED`: Writing an output file failed (path and OS error in `data`).
- `BUSY`: A concurrency cap was reached; the request can be retried later.
- `SESSION_INACTIVE`: The input session isn't active: still counting down, paused because the user took over, or ended (`data.state`).
- `TIMEOUT`: The request's timeout expired.
- `CANCELLED`: The request or job was cancelled.
- `MAIN_THREAD_UNAVAILABLE`: The game's main thread isn't processing requests (loading or hung).
- `INTERNAL`: An agent defect. Always logged with full details.

data.title: ErrorData

param.description: Name or path of the offending parameter.

data.description: Structured details. Keys depend on the code.
